items.title: Can Lincoln National Turn Greater Capital Flexibility Into Growth?
items.summary: LNC is shifting from capital rebuilding to flexibility, with stronger liquidity, lower leverage and new room to pursue growth and returns.

items.title: Higher Rates Are a Gift to These 3 Insurance Dividend Stocks
items.summary: Insurance companies collect your premiums today and settle your claims years from now, and that gap is quietly becoming a profit engine as rates stay elevated. Three insurers are turning this float mechanic into dividend growth that outlasted a pandemic, an inflation shock, and back-to-back catastrophe years.

items.title: 3 Reasons to Avoid MET and 1 Stock to Buy Instead
